subject: n2r v2 review: legacy validator blocks richer spans; address array is positional
body: Reviewed new n2r_build_v2 diff. Two integration blockers: (1) build_impl still calls n2r_validate(s,q)->gd_request_ok, whose old texture path requires memory.bytes == row_bytes*height and only narrow formats. A real multi-mip/array/3D span in q.memory.bytes therefore refuses before sidecar use. Do NOT keep q.memory.bytes=mip0 and let tb.backing_length access beyond the bridge-resolved span. Add explicit v2 validation that checks richer sidecar against the SAME retained whole memory span; bridge resolver must resolve complete required span. Keep legacy validator/path unchanged. (2) n2r_addresses.binding is indexed by q.bindings ARRAY POSITION i, as resources() correctly uses a->binding[i]; new header comment says binding[binding] (nativeN), which is wrong for sparse binding numbers. Clarify this now for compute bridge owner, and test q.bindings[0].binding=3 and q.bindings[1].binding=9 with distinct BOs. Reject orphan sidecar entries absent from q and contradictory/missing required sidecars before any GPU submit.
